cards.ex: This research sheds light on the causes of climate change.
cards.exUz: Bu tadqiqot iqlim o'zgarishining sabablariga oydinlik kiritadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushuntirishga yoki aniqlashtirishga yordam bermoq.

cards.ex: In light of the evidence, we need to reconsider our approach.
cards.exUz: Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, biz yondashuvimizni qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror faktni hisobga olgan holda yoki sababidan kelib chiqib.

cards.ex: I want to draw attention to the lack of resources in schools.
cards.exUz: Maktablardagi resurslarning yetishmasligiga e'tiborni qaratmoqchiman.

cards.ex: The new policy will build upon the successes of the previous one.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat avvalgi siyosatning muvaffaqiyatlariga asoslanadi.

cards.ex: The report delves into the history of the conflict.
cards.exUz: Hisobot mojarolarning tarixiga chuqur kiradi.

cards.ex: With regard to your question, I need more time to answer.
cards.exUz: Savolingizga nisbatan, javob berish uchun menga ko'proq vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida yoki biror narsaga aloqador.

cards.ex: His problems stem from a difficult childhood.
cards.exUz: Uning muammolari og'ir bolalikdan kelib chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababi yoki manbai bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Bear in mind that the deadline is next week.
cards.exUz: Muddat keyingi hafta ekanligini yodda tuting.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani esda saqlamoq yoki unutmaslik.

cards.ex: The project was successful to the extent that it exceeded our expectations.
cards.exUz: Loyiha shunday darajada muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldiki, u bizning kutganimizdan ham oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa shunchalik katta yoki kuchliki...

cards.ex: The appeal was rejected on the grounds that there was no new evidence.
cards.exUz: Apellyatsiya yangi dalillar yo'qligi sababi bilan rad etildi.

cards.ex: In contrast to previous studies, this one found different results.
cards.exUz: Avvalgi tadqiqotlardan farqli o'laroq, bu tadqiqot boshqa natijalarni ko'rsatdi.

cards.ex: The library has a wealth of information on the subject.
cards.exUz: Kutubxonada bu mavzu bo'yicha ko'p ma'lumot bor.

cards.ex: This discovery could pave the way for new treatments.
cards.exUz: Bu kashfiyot yangi davolash usullari uchun yo'l ochishi mumkin.

cards.ex: In essence, the argument is about money.
cards.exUz: Aslida, bahs pul haqida.

cards.ex: It is worth noting that the data is incomplete.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotlar to'liq emasligini ta'kidlash kerak.

cards.ex: To put it another way, the system is not working.
cards.exUz: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, tizim ishlamayapti.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shu narsani boshqacha so'zlar bilan ifodalash.

cards.ex: The plan is environmentally friendly; moreover, it's cost-effective.
cards.exUz: Reja atrof-muhitga zarar keltirmaydi; qolaversa, bu tejamkor.

cards.ex: The company's success is a case in point for the benefits of investing in technology.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning muvaffaqiyati texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritishning afzalliklariga misol.

cards.ex: By and large, people are supportive of the new law.
cards.exUz: Umuman olganda, odamlar yangi qonunni qo'llab-quvvatlamoqda.

cards.ex: Investing in education is beneficial in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda foydali.

cards.ex: On the one hand, it's expensive; on the other hand, it's a good investment.
cards.exUz: Bir tomondan, bu qimmat; boshqa tomondan, bu yaxshi sarmoya.

cards.ex: To a certain extent, I agree with you.
cards.exUz: Ma'lum darajada sizga qo'shilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qisman to'g'ri yoki haqiqatga yaqin.

cards.ex: Many animals hibernate, for instance, bears and squirrels.
cards.exUz: Ko'p hayvonlar qish uyqusiga ketadi, masalan, ayiqlar va olmaxonlar.

cards.ex: The increase in sales accounts for the company's profits.
cards.exUz: Sotuvlarning ko'payishi kompaniyaning foydasini izohlaydi.

cards.ex: The roads were icy; as a result, there were many accidents.
cards.exUz: Yo'llar muz edi; natijada, ko'plab baxtsiz hodisalar yuz berdi.

cards.ex: In summary, the project was a success.
cards.exUz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

cards.ex: To reiterate, the deadline is next Friday.
cards.exUz: Takrorlayman, oxirgi muddat kelasi juma.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yana bir bor aytmoq yoki ta'kidlamoq.

cards.ex: Motivation is a key factor in student success.
cards.exUz: Motivatsiya talabalarning muvaffaqiyatida asosiy omil.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ta'sir qiluvchi muhim narsa.

cards.ex: The proposal is currently under consideration.
cards.exUz: Taklif hozirda ko'rib chiqilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda muhokama qilinayotgan yoki rejalashtirilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: It is important to note that the results are preliminary.
cards.exUz: Natijalar dastlabki ekanligini ta'kidlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga alohida e'tibor berish kerak.
